reply.text:
That sounds unsettling, and it is one for a doctor, not a coach. An electric feeling running down the spine when you look down needs to be assessed in person, so please book with your doctor soon, and if it comes with weakness, numbness, trouble walking, or changes in bladder or bowel control, get seen urgently. I can't tell you what it is or whether it's serious.

Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say about any training limits and I'll build around it. Until then, I'd hold off on heavy loading and anything that makes the feeling worse.
